name: Meetup Groups - Gaming
description: Board game, chess, RPG, mahjong, pinball, puzzle and video game groups around San Diego County, collected from their Meetup pages.

groups.name: San Diego Social Chess Club
groups.description: Casual, friendly chess for beginners through masters at outdoor shaded tables. Registering is encouraged but not required. Just show up and play. Usually 4–8 players.
groups.address: Clairemont Town Square, 4705 Clairemont Dr, San Diego (outside the former Reading Cinemas)

groups.name: The San Diego Roleplaying Association
groups.description: Connects local GMs who need players with players who need games. Welcomes new and experienced players and runs RPGs of all kinds, from D&D to Fiasco, plus one-shots and convention meetups.
groups.address: Various: Tea n More and Forbidden Cove (Clairemont Mesa Blvd), Off The Shelf Games (El Cajon), At Ease Games (Miramar Rd), Enzo's BBQ Ale House (Encinitas)

groups.name: Queerly Allies Board Gamers SD
groups.description: An LGBTQ+ (and allies) board gaming group building friendships through tabletop games. A safe, adults-only space for board and card games, located between Hillcrest and University Heights.
groups.address: The Nash, 4135 Park Blvd, San Diego

groups.name: The 56 Board Game Group
groups.description: An open, inclusive board gaming group hosting events within a few miles of the Route 56 corridor. Organizers love teaching games. Library events are open to all ages, including young kids.
groups.address: At Ease Games, 8400 Miramar Rd, San Diego; Pacific Highlands Ranch Library, 12911 Pacific Point Pl, San Diego
groups.frequency: Wednesdays 6:00 PM at At Ease Games; every other Saturday 1:00 PM at the library

cost.note: $2 for At Ease Games events; some special events $10

groups.name: San Diego Mahjong Club
groups.description: San Diego's largest mahjong club, focused on authentic Asian styles. Mainly plays Zung Jung, a beginner-friendly Chinese variant, plus Japanese Riichi and MCR.
groups.address: Ding Tea, 8280 Mira Mesa Blvd Suite C (Wed); AleSmith Brewing, 9990 AleSmith Ct (Sun); Friday venues rotate
groups.frequency: Wednesdays 6:00 PM, Fridays 5:00 PM, Sundays 11:00 AM

groups.name: RaD North County: Rockin' and Dancing Active Social Group
groups.description: A group of active people who love music, dancing and socializing, based mainly in North County. Besides dance events, they hold hikes, walks, happy hours, trivia and game nights.
groups.address: Various North County venues (Escondido, Carlsbad, Encinitas, Solana Beach)

groups.name: San Diego Pinball Club
groups.description: Pinball fans of all ages and skill levels, from veterans to first-timers. Mostly promotes local tournaments and leagues. Some events are at 21+ venues.
groups.address: Various: Brewski's Bar & Arcade (8760 Miramar Rd), Aero Club Bar, The Hills Pub (La Mesa), The Lost Abbey (Vista), The Brew Inn (Oceanside)
groups.frequency: Fall League every other Tuesday 6:30 PM at Brewski's; monthly tournaments at several bars

groups.name: Carlsbad Boardgame Meetup Group
groups.description: A friendly, casual group that loves playing and teaching board games. Games are provided and you can bring your own. Food and drinks are for sale, and 10–20 people usually come.
groups.address: Windmill Food Hall, 890 Palomar Airport Rd, Carlsbad

groups.name: Casual chess and board games in Encinitas 21+
groups.description: San Diego Chess & Social's Encinitas night, with 60–100 people on average. No chess experience needed. Backgammon, Uno, Wavelength and more.
groups.address: Union Kitchen & Tap, 1108 S Coast Hwy 101, Encinitas

groups.name: North County Blood on the Clocktower
groups.description: Evenings of the social deduction game Blood on the Clocktower. All skill levels welcome, from seasoned players to newcomers.
groups.address: The Tavern at Barley and Sword, 800 W Grand Ave, Escondido

groups.name: San Diego North County Board Games
groups.description: Play board and card games and meet others who love them. Members are encouraged to teach games they know and to host their own sessions.
groups.address: Pair A Dice Games, 2020 Hacienda Dr, Vista

groups.name: Tabletop Game Meetup at The Boarding Home Cafe
groups.description: Board games, card games and RPGs at The Boarding Home Game Cafe, from classics like Catan and Ticket to Ride to modern favorites. Good for experienced players and beginners.
groups.address: The Boarding Home, 300 Carlsbad Village Dr #103, Carlsbad

groups.name: North County Gamers
groups.description: Aims to encourage more in-person gaming in North County by listing local gaming events and venues. Hosts video game nights, LAN parties and card swaps for all skill levels.
groups.address: Pizza Port Tasting Room, 155 Mata Way Ste 104, San Marcos

groups.name: Social, Hikes, Drinks, Games . . . FUN of San Diego
groups.description: A group for anyone who wants to have fun and meet people. The main events calendar is on SocialFundation.com.
groups.address: Silvergate Three Stars Masonic, 3795 Utah St, San Diego
groups.frequency: Beginner line dancing & swing Mondays 6:30 PM; plus online events

groups.name: Casual Chess & Board Games in PB! San Diego Chess & Social
groups.description: Weekly, very casual chess and board game night at a PB tavern, usually 70–140 people. Chess boards provided. Most players are new, but some are rated 2000+. Yahtzee, backgammon, Jenga and more, with $6 beers.
groups.address: Tavern at the Beach, 1200 Garnet Ave, Pacific Beach

groups.name: The Hoppy Dice Board Game Nights!
groups.description: A pop-up that brings board game nights to San Diego bars and breweries, with 30+ games each night from a 70+ game collection. No experience needed. Come with friends or make new ones.
groups.address: Rotating bars and breweries (e.g. Hopnonymous Normal Heights, Pure Project North Park, Burgeon at The Arbor, Ballast Point Little Italy, bar Ella PB)
groups.frequency: Several nights a week on a recurring schedule (subject to change; weekly schedule on Instagram)

groups.name: Pacific Puzzlers
groups.description: Competitive jigsaw puzzling and puzzle swaps at San Diego bars and breweries. Formats for individuals, pairs and teams. Register on their website.
groups.address: Rotating: Original 40 Brewing (3117 University Ave), Elijah's (Clairemont), AleSmith Brewing (Miramar), Main Street Pour House (Vista)
groups.frequency: Mondays 6:00 PM; some midweek events in Vista

groups.name: The San Diego LAN Party Meetup Group
groups.description: Social PC gaming with a house-party feel, mixing strategy and FPS games. They also run the PC gaming rooms at local conventions.
groups.address: San Diego LAN HQ, 4319 Corral Canyon Rd, Bonita

cost.note: Regular meetups free; special events like the LAN-A-THON have been $30

groups.name: East County Tabletop Roleplaying and Board Games Group
groups.description: New and experienced gamers meet for board games and RPGs in a comfortable, welcoming setting. Families welcome. Anyone under 18 must come with an adult guardian.
groups.address: Off The Shelf Games, 173 Fletcher Pkwy, El Cajon
groups.frequency: Sundays 12:00 PM open board gaming; Mondays 4:00 PM MTG Commander; Tuesdays 6:00 PM miniature war games

groups.name: San Diego Introverts Socializing
groups.description: For people who prefer quieter or smaller-group activities, such as board game nights, café craft hangouts and introvert happy hours.
groups.address: Liberty Public Market, 2820 Historic Decatur Rd, San Diego (game nights); Playground Art + Coffee, 3043 University Ave (other events)

groups.name: San Diego Singles/Soloers Network
groups.description: Singles meeting new friends through fun activities around San Diego. Events include dinners, game nights, murder mysteries, scavenger hunts and speed dating.
groups.address: Various (Casa de Maria in Old Town, Balboa Park, Mission Valley, Escondido, Encinitas)
